name: branched-menu
title: Branched Menu
description: A compact vertical navigation menu where each section hangs off a central trunk with curved branch lines. Sections expand and collapse, and the selected child gets an accent line traced back along the branch to the trunk.
use: A docs or settings nav needs to show nested sections and make the current page obvious.
avoid: It is a fixed narrow column with dark-only line colours and needs a hand-built items tree.
a11y: Keyboard and ARIA state are handled, but the buttons remove the focus outline without offering a replacement. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A narrow dark rounded panel with a faint vertical trunk on its left. Bold section labels sit on the trunk, and each expanded section shows indented child rows with small icons, joined by thin curved branch lines.
behaves: Clicking a section title folds its children open or closed with a smooth height change. Clicking a child marks it active, draws an accent line from the trunk to its row, and slides the section marker.
customise: Props set the items tree, which sections start open, the active value, selection callbacks, and the width, row height, indents, colours, font and durations.
weight: light: A small static tree; only CSS height and stroke transitions run when toggling or selecting.
demo: Docs sections Getting started and Components, with children such as Installation and Buttons.
issues: The section and child buttons have no visible focus ring.
polishWhy: Charming branch lines and tidy type; the dark low-contrast labels are hard to scan.
